palette.notes: Code: 46 colours at 16x scale (36x64 native), one long ramp, 25 deg hue shift. Near-black blue-grey cave, crimson cape as the hero accent, gold spikes as hazard colour, white-cyan slash FX.

lighting: Dark ambient cave with no strong key; readability comes from value: pale slash FX and gold spikes glow against near-black stone, crimson cape is the only warm mid-tone.
silhouette: Small knight with oversized flowing red cape and long sword; cape mass makes every pose read even at tiny size. Spikes are saw-tooth bands that read as danger instantly.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 50 ms (p25 33.3, p75 50), 20.57 drawings/s, about 1.5 on-frames: fast game action, largely on ones/twos with FX on ones.

texture: Clean pixels, dither share 0.005; flat stone blocks with chunky light edges, slash arcs drawn as crisp crescent shapes.
camera: Gameplay camera following the hero vertically through a narrow shaft; quick screen-to-screen moves; enemy hit flashes the frame with white FX.

acting.enters: Starts mid-action with a spin slash; no idle intro.
acting.acts: Chains slash, wall-cling, dash and pogo attacks between spike walls; hits a burrowing enemy with a white impact burst.
acting.exits: Dashes out of frame with long motion-streak afterimages, then the cut to the TikTok end card.
acting.depth: Dim arched doors and pillars sit far back in low contrast; hero and spikes stay in the bright front layer.

techniques: crescent smear frames for sword swings
dash afterimage streaks trailing the sprite
oversized cape as follow-through and silhouette mass
one warm accent (red cape) on a cold near-black set
feel: near-black cave + crimson cape hero + crescent smears and dash streaks = snappy, readable metroidvania flow
for_fred: Give Fred one big trailing shape (a long tail fin) that lags and settles after every move, and when he dashes off screen leave 2-3 fading afterimages so the exit is a beat, not a vanish.
